stories.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 Proposing Public Listing
stories.blurb: Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus to go public, detailing its financial growth, corporate governance, and significant long-term compute commitments.

stories.headline: Google Announces Gemini 4 Carbon Frontier Model
stories.blurb: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon as its latest flagship AI model designed for advanced multi-modal reasoning and complex enterprise workflows.

stories.headline: DOJ Probes Nvidia's $12.9B Acquisition of Hugging Face
stories.blurb: The U.S. Department of Justice is scrutinizing Nvidia's planned acquisition of Hugging Face over antitrust concerns in the AI ecosystem.

stories.headline: FuriosaAI Raises $620M for Energy-Efficient Inference Chips
stories.blurb: AI chipmaker FuriosaAI secured $620 million to scale specialized inference silicon aimed at addressing power constraints in data centers.

stories.headline: GitHub Debuts Copilot Fusion and Expands Infrastructure
stories.blurb: GitHub announced Copilot Fusion and added 4 million CPU cores to support rising demand for agent-driven software development.

stories.headline: Supabase Launches OrioleDB Public Beta for PostgreSQL
stories.blurb: Supabase released the public beta of OrioleDB, a modern PostgreSQL storage engine optimized for update-heavy database workloads.

stories.headline: Microsoft Releases Copilot Harness for Multi-Model Agents
stories.blurb: Microsoft introduced a orchestration harness to help developers build and govern multi-model agentic AI workflows.

stories.headline: Android Studio Integrates Native AI Coding Agents
stories.blurb: Google has built popular AI development agents directly into Android Studio to streamline mobile app creation.

stories.headline: Wiz Discovers PHP2Shell Remote Code Execution Flaws
stories.blurb: Security researchers at Wiz uncovered severe vulnerabilities in PHP that allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected servers.

stories.headline: Apple Git Toolchain Retains Compromised eMudhra Certificates
stories.blurb: Security analysts warned that Apple's Git distribution still trusts compromised eMudhra root certificates, leaving developers exposed to supply chain risks.

stories.headline: Upwind Raises $400M After Turning Down Datadog Buyout
stories.blurb: Cloud security startup Upwind secured $400 million in funding to expand independently after rejecting an acquisition offer from Datadog.

stories.headline: Cisco Unveils Project Quarry for AI Agent Defense
stories.blurb: Cisco launched Project Quarry, an open framework designed to detect security threats and enforce guardrails around autonomous AI agents.
